review.reviewer: Claude (independent authoring pass; benchmark expansion task for NON_DOING_MARKERS)
review.methodology: Every case's expected value was decided by reading the sentence as a document and applying the definitions already documented in app/services/matching/vocabulary.py and evidence.py: is_non_doing asks whether a clause says a technology was NOT used, and demonstrates() asks whether a clause shows the work was done rather than contemplated. No case's expected value was produced by running is_non_doing, demonstrates, or any matching rule. The defect_class on each case is a PREDICTION, authored at the same time as the expected value and before the benchmark runner existed, of what kind of mismatch (if any) the case would reveal: tokenizer, vocabulary, clause_context, attribution or evidence_model — see schema.py for the definitions. Pipeline cases additionally separate the five stages the task asked to be measured independently: non-doing classification, technology attribution, evidence tier, experience duration, and requirement verdict, so a case can show stage 1 succeeding while stage 4 or 5 still fails downstream.
review.independence_statement: No verdict, tier, duration or attribution expectation in this dataset was derived by running is_non_doing(), demonstrates(), or any function in app.services.matching. This file must not be edited to agree with the implementation's output; a disagreement is a finding to report, not an error to fix by changing this file. See tests/test_nondoing_benchmark_independence.py for the structural, textual and behavioural proof.
